about_short_description.short_description: doola is a business services companies that offers SMBs registration, banking, payments, compliance and tax related services.

product.name: Formation
product.description: U.S. business formation services for entrepreneurs, including LLC filing, EIN applications, operating agreements, registered agent service, business addresses, and compliance support.

product.name: Taxes
product.description: Business tax services covering federal and state filings, sales tax setup, reseller certificates, estimated taxes, and consultations with tax professionals.

product.name: Bookkeeping
product.description: A financial management and bookkeeping service for tracking transactions, categorizing income and expenses, linking bank accounts, preparing reports, and maintaining business records.

product.name: Analytics
product.description: E-commerce analytics for monitoring sales, orders, transactions, financial metrics, and advertising performance through integrations such as Shopify and Amazon.

product.name: AI Co-Founder
product.description: An AI-based business assistant that answers questions about a company and provides on-demand support for founders through doola’s platform.

product.name: Business Banking and Payments Access
product.description: Business banking setup guidance and access to partner banking and payment infrastructure to help entrepreneurs separate business finances and accept payments.
